_meta.authority_chain: Until the engine emits this file, SOURCE WINS on any divergence: src/interfaceModule/app_command_init.cpp (registration), src/interfaceModule/base_command_interface.hpp (token spellings), src/interfaceModule/app_command_interface.cpp (parse + handlers). Target state: the engine generates this file (AppCommandInit already keeps commandList/flagList/colorList/setList copies 'to futur exploitation'; SessionFile::CommandSurface forEach* hooks cover flags/values/colors) and this file becomes a build artifact. Cross-check reference: claude/capability-surface.md (census 2026-07-25, counts dated).
_meta.count_deltas_vs_census_2026_07_25: commands 60 vs census 59: 'session' landed with B31 (INTENT §11.128 era). flags/set/colors unchanged (97/43/46).
_meta.documentation_requirement: [vixy 2026-08-03] Each command AND each key carries its own line of documentation, shown interactively by cursor position; defaults shown greyed out and offered as completion when the value field is empty. Bar: someone without any knowledge of script should be able to understand and modify any script through this editor. Docs are PRODUCT SURFACE: a doc line exists only where its content is traced (handler code, ledger, or Vixy); untraceable gaps are flagged, never invented. Planned schema v2: every family names-array becomes [{name, doc, default?}] when the doc pass fills content.
_meta.diagnostic_id_style: [vixy 2026-08-03] GNU-style kebab-case ids (unknown-command, unknown-parameter, deprecated, ...); --check output surfaces them gcc-style: file:line: severity: message [-Wid]

parse_model._source: AppCommandInterface::parseCommand, app_command_interface.cpp:124-176; executeCommand :191-302; setFlag :306-321; script layer script.cpp:114
parse_model.line_shape: COMMAND (KEY VALUE)*  — first whitespace token is the command, remainder consumed as strict key/value pairs
parse_model.pair_extraction: std::istringstream 'while (str >> key >> value)': a trailing KEY with no VALUE is SILENTLY DROPPED (extraction fails mid-pair, loop exits)
parse_model.duplicate_keys: args is std::map<string,string> (tools/utility.hpp:85): a repeated key in one line keeps the LAST value; handlers iterating args see keys in ALPHABETICAL order, not line order

quoting.quote_char: double quote ONLY — single quotes are ordinary characters; there is NO escape sequence
quoting.multi_word: opening quote pulls raw chars (spaces included) until the next '"' or end of line; an unclosed quote consumes to end of line without error
quoting.space_after_quote_normalization: any ' " ' (space,quote,space) has the char after the quote erased before tokenizing (parseCommand:135-139) — a space directly after an opening/closing quote in ' " ' form disappears

comments.script_layer: a line is dropped iff its FIRST byte is '#', 0, CR or LF (script.cpp:114). An INDENTED '#' is NOT a comment — the line reaches the parser and '#...' becomes an unknown command.
comments.live_channels: TCP / HTTP / pipe / joypad strings get NO comment stripping at all
comments.block_form: 'comment' / 'uncomment' commands toggle a skip state (intercepted before table lookup, executeCommand:215-219); skipped lines are logged 'this command has not been executed'
comments.verify_next: script_mgr.cpp:94 has a second '#' site — role not yet extracted

parse_model.pre_table_commands: comment, uncomment, struct are literal-compared BEFORE m_commands lookup (:215-222); comment/uncomment are NOT in m_commands, so the did-you-mean can never suggest them (struct is also registered)
parse_model.unknown_command: debug_message 'Unrecognized or malformed command name' + Levenshtein nearest-neighbour suggestion over the family list (searchNeighbour, app_command_init.cpp:368-387; no distance threshold — a suggestion is always produced, log-only)

flag_value_grammar.accepted: toggle | on-values via Utility::isTrue | EVERYTHING ELSE silently means OFF
flag_value_grammar.consequence: a typo in a flag value is a silent 'off' — no diagnostic exists engine-side

parse_model.flag_multi_pair: commandFlag reads only args.begin() — with multiple pairs on one 'flag' line, only the ALPHABETICALLY FIRST key is applied, silently (census §3.8; same single-pair restriction: define/add/sub/multiply/divide/modulo/tangent/trunc/sinus)
parse_model.recording_alias_loss: m_commands_ToString is built by emplace(enum, name) over the alphabetical name map: 'camera' claims SC_CAMERA before 'flyto', so a recorded 'flyto' round-trips as 'camera'

commands._args_status: args specs UNEXTRACTED for every command — the per-handler sweep of app_command_interface.cpp (4747 lines) is the next extraction pass; nothing here is guessed

lint_seeds.rule: unknown command name (with Levenshtein suggestion, threshold-capped unlike the engine's)
unknown flag/set/color name for its subfamily
obsolete token (7 names) — engine silently no-ops with a debug log
'flag sky_draw' — name spelled in the header but never registered; engine treats it as unknown
odd token count after command — engine silently drops the trailing key
duplicate key in one line — engine keeps the LAST value silently
multiple pairs on 'flag' (and define/add/sub/multiply/divide/modulo/tangent/trunc/sinus): engine applies only the alphabetically-first pair
flag value not in {on-forms, off-forms, toggle}: engine reads it as OFF silently
indented '#': NOT a comment at the script layer — becomes an unknown command
single quotes or backslash escapes: the engine parser has neither (sts-extension currently highlights both as if legal)
'flyto' records back as 'camera' — round-trip changes the spelling
'set mode' parses and reports success but does nothing engine-side
